svg.title: GOX injector choke margin against manifold pressure
svg.desc: Choke margin p0/Pc of the GOX injector at steady burning, for eta_c* values, with the injector holes as drawn and with holes scaled to keep the design flow. uncalibrated · stand sim ec34dd4 · 2026-09-27.
svg.text: GOX injector choke margin p₀/P_c vs manifold pressure
dotted at 1.893: O₂ critical ratio; below it the injector is not choked

svg.text: uncalibrated · stand sim ec34dd4 · 2026-09-27. Steady burn on the chamber-fill network, CEA c*.
Holes as drawn: P_c rises with manifold pressure and the margin stays put. The S-3 target and fix are Dalton's.
